description: Key-agreement recipient selection from a did:dht DID document. The document is taken verbatim from the did:dht method specification's published test vector 3, which declares a keyAgreement relationship referencing an X25519 verification method. The expected recipient key is the X25519 public key and verification-method id the spec vector publishes — hardcoded spec literals, NOT recomputed by the impl on the expected side. Only the `service` entry is omitted; it plays no part in recipient selection.

spec.name: The DID DHT Method
spec.section: Test Vectors — Vector 3 (document with keyAgreement, gateways, and previous-DID proof)

vector.note: The vector's own DNS encoding carries the key-agreement key as `_k1._did. TXT t=3;k=3POE0_i2mGeZ2qiQCA3KcLfi1fZo0311CXFSIwt1nB4`, which is the same key material asserted here. DNS-packet decoding is covered separately by the did:dht resolver tests; this set asserts recipient selection over the resulting document.

cases.description: keyAgreement holds an absolute DID URL referencing an X25519 verification method in the same document. Selection dereferences the fragment, returns the X25519 key public-only, and preserves the source verification-method id as the recipient key id. The Ed25519 verification method (#0) is declared for authentication/assertionMethod and MUST NOT be selected.
